## Core Architectural Principles

- **100% Full IP Ownership**: Clients retain complete ownership of all source code, databases, design tokens, CI/CD pipelines, and intellectual property. Zero vendor lock-in.
- **Direct Senior Architecture**: Projects are led directly by senior engineers and technical architects. Zero junior account manager telephone games.
- **Weekly Functional Previews**: Clients test working software in production-grade staging environments every 7 days, avoiding static slide decks.
- **24-Hour Scope & Roadmap**: Every brief receives a structured milestone roadmap, architectural breakdown, and transparent investment estimate within 24 hours.
- **Sector Regulatory Compliance**: Deep architectural adherence to domain regulations, including the National Medical Commission (NMC) Guidelines on Ethical Advertising (Oct 6, 2026), HIPAA, and GDPR.
